static.scope: main process CPU and resident mappings; child processes excluded; mapped driver/software-GPU memory may contribute to RSS

video.scope: main process CPU and resident mappings; child processes excluded; mapped driver/software-GPU memory may contribute to RSS

workload.comparison: Current static and playback samples only; not a controlled comparison with older binaries.

assessment.scope: Two current workload samples. Software rendering contributes to process CPU/RSS; this is not a controlled before/after comparison with older releases.

procedure: Use the recorded build on one 1920x1080 output at scale 1, with profiling disabled and the five existing widgets visible.
Sample the settled static desktop after a service restart.
Import a copy of the 1280x800 H.264 landscape loop, set 15 FPS with native controls, close the panel and warm playback for five seconds before the second sample.
Verify the decoder remains active and background submissions advance through the sample; restore exact settings, wallpaper, exports and idle policy.

background_submission_scope: Counters sampled around the 120-second process interval include SSH/inspection overhead; submissions are not scanout acknowledgements or an isolated frame-pacing benchmark.
